model: SixRULNet GRU, hidden 64, quantile outputs (10th, 50th, 90th percentile of log RUL), trained with randomly hidden indicators and random end-of-life limits
trajectory_model: TrajectoryNet GRU, hidden 64: 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of each indicator's fraction of its limit at 10 points to end of life
training_data: Simulated capacitors from caplife.six_sim; not real measurements
